content.title: Alibaba Stock Falls on U.S.-China Tensions. It May Be an AI Buying Opportunity.
content.summary: Alibaba  Baidu, JD.com, and other Chinese tech stocks were falling Friday as continued trade tensions between the U.S. and China heaped pressure on companies listed in Hong Kong.  It could be a buying opportunity, especially for Alibaba.  American depositary receipts, or ADRs, for  Alibaba  —essentially the company’s U.S.-listed stock—fell 1.5% in U.S. premarket trading on Friday.
